scope: Independent final-source review and isolated Go tests. Native WebView behavior is recorded separately. No real client configuration, credentials, upstream services, or model calls accessed.
reviewChecks: Exactly five adapter summary rows and seven fields per row; no source content or credentials returned.
Scans create no preview plan or persistent state and do not execute source expressions.
Preview takes only a known source ID, reselects candidate and resolves current symlink, rereads bounded current content, then uses existing import preview.
Missing, invalid, non-regular, oversized and unresolved OMP override configurations report per-source status.
CodeBuddy display name maps to its existing JSONC and normalization source.
App-generated stdio connect structure is blocked and defaults to skip; a same-name ordinary service is allowed.
Seven remaining native select controls use a shared semantic fieldset and native radio component, unique names and typed string or number models.
Import scan is triggered by entering the import page or explicit refresh; snapshot polling does not call it.
limits: Tests use temporary HOME and six additional path/profile environment variables.
The 10 MB growth bound is implemented with LimitReader; tests cover exact size and oversized files, not an adversarial live file-swap race.
Native radio OS keyboard defaults and pixel focus appearance require separate real-device checks.
